fp-intro.title: Fidelity · What is technical analysis?
fp-intro.supports: Technical analysis studies market-generated data; distinction from fundamental analysis. Educational description, not validation of the fictional examples.

fp-charts.title: Fidelity · What are charts?
fp-charts.supports: Line, OHLC, and candlestick chart conventions.

fp-trends.title: Fidelity · Basic concepts of trend
fp-trends.supports: Conventional peak/trough trend classification and trendline construction.

fp-levels.title: Fidelity · Support and resistance
fp-levels.supports: Support/resistance vocabulary and the conventional role-reversal hypothesis; not a guarantee of future reactions.

fp-volume.title: Fidelity · Why to consider stock volume
fp-volume.supports: Share-volume definition and comparison with historical activity.

fp-orders.title: SEC / Investor.gov · Types of orders
fp-orders.supports: Market, limit, and stop order distinctions; execution prices and fills are not guaranteed by a chart level.

fp-sessions.title: SEC / Investor.gov · Extended-hours trading: investor bulletin
fp-sessions.supports: Regular versus extended trading sessions; differences in liquidity, spreads, and available trading data.

fp-actions.title: FINRA · Corporate actions by public companies
fp-actions.supports: Stock-split mechanics and distinction between share count and proportionate ownership.

fp-candles.title: StockCharts ChartSchool · Introduction to candlesticks
fp-candles.supports: Doji and long-shadow pattern terminology, prior-trend context, and the inability of OHLC to reveal transaction sequence. Numerical thresholds here are original teaching conventions.

fp-patterns.title: Fidelity · Identifying chart patterns with technical analysis
fp-patterns.supports: Engulfing-body vocabulary, triangle categories, breakout filters, false breaks, and retracements. This book does not adopt the slides' performance claims.

fp-doubletop.title: StockCharts ChartSchool · Double top reversal
fp-doubletop.supports: Two-peak construction, intervening support break, and conventional measured-move calculation.

fp-headshoulders.title: StockCharts ChartSchool · Head and shoulders top
fp-headshoulders.supports: Shoulder/head/neckline construction and the need to distinguish formation from completion.

fp-flags.title: StockCharts ChartSchool · Flag and pennant
fp-flags.supports: Short consolidation after a sharp move; flag versus pennant geometry.

fp-research.title: Lo, Mamaysky & Wang · Foundations of technical analysis (NBER working paper 7613)
fp-research.supports: Research on formalized pattern recognition and incremental information in a historical US-stock sample. Does not establish a universal, current, after-cost trading edge.

fp-quotes.title: SEC / Investor.gov · Bid price / ask price
fp-quotes.supports: Bid, ask, and bid–ask spread definitions. All quote arithmetic examples are fictional.

fp-triangle.title: StockCharts ChartSchool · Symmetrical triangle
fp-triangle.supports: Converging lower highs and higher lows; distinction between pattern geometry and observed breakout direction; filter and retest conventions. No performance percentages are adopted here.

fp-breakoutareas.title: StockCharts ChartSchool · Support and resistance
fp-breakoutareas.supports: Breaks of previously defined trading areas, approximate zones, role-change and failed-crossing vocabulary. The numerical breakout and failure rules in this book are original fictional examples.

fp-order-bulletin.title: SEC / Investor.gov · Understanding Order Types
fp-order-bulletin.supports: Market/limit/stop/stop-limit execution, nonfills, trigger conventions, IOC cancellation; definitions only, not assumed fill probabilities.

ic-sma.title: Fidelity · Simple moving average
ic-sma.supports: Arithmetic moving-average definition and smoothing/lag tradeoff; no claim of profitable crossover rules.

ic-ema.title: Fidelity · Exponential moving average
ic-ema.supports: Recursive EMA definition and SMA seed convention.

ic-rsi.title: Fidelity · Relative Strength Index
ic-rsi.supports: RSI definition, formula, conventional thresholds, and persistence during strong trends.

ic-atr.title: Fidelity · Average True Range
ic-atr.supports: True-range maximum and recursive ATR update.

ic-bands.title: Fidelity · Bollinger Bands
ic-bands.supports: Moving-average envelopes, standard-deviation multiplier, and conventional 20/2 setting.

ic-obv.title: Fidelity · On Balance Volume
ic-obv.supports: Cumulative signed-volume formula, including unchanged-close treatment.

ic-fibonacci.title: Fidelity · Fibonacci retracement
ic-fibonacci.supports: Common drawing convention and anchor-based percentage levels; not evidence of an economic law.

ic-relative.title: Fidelity · Relative Strength Comparison
ic-relative.supports: Price ratio definition and interpretation of relative performance.

ic-vwap.title: TradingView · Volume Weighted Average Price
ic-vwap.supports: Bar-based VWAP formula, price-source choice, and session/reset convention.

ic-timeframes.title: TradingView · Other timeframes and data
ic-timeframes.supports: Developing higher-timeframe bars, confirmation, and lookahead/repainting risks; not evidence of profitable timeframe alignment.

ic-hours.title: SEC / Investor.gov · Extended-hours trading
ic-hours.supports: News releases outside regular hours, liquidity/spread/price uncertainty, and venue-dependent order handling.

ic-orders.title: SEC / Investor.gov · Types of orders
ic-orders.supports: Market and limit orders, stop-to-market conversion, and execution-price uncertainty.

ic-auctions.title: NYSE · Auctions
ic-auctions.supports: Exchange auction mechanisms and indicative match/imbalance definitions; current rules can change.

ic-splits.title: SEC / Investor.gov · Stock split
ic-splits.supports: Split mechanics: a two-for-one split doubles share count and halves price per share without diluting ownership (100 shares at $100 become 200 at $50). Comparability of price histories across a split is the book’s inference.

ic-rsi-smoothing.title: TradingView · Relative Strength Index
ic-rsi-smoothing.supports: Separate positive gain and loss magnitudes and RMA smoothing; not evidence of predictive accuracy.

ic-dividends.title: SEC / Investor.gov · Ex-dividend dates
ic-dividends.supports: Distribution-related price changes on an ex-dividend date; entitlement rules require current verification.

ic-execution.title: SEC / Investor.gov · Executing an order
ic-execution.supports: Broker routing and multiple market venues; order receipt and execution are separate events.

ic-spread.title: FINRA · Understanding market liquidity and your investments
ic-spread.supports: Bid, ask, spread, and the link between limited liquidity and execution difficulty.

ic-roc.title: Fidelity · Rate of Change
ic-roc.supports: Price change versus N earlier observations and percent-rate convention.

ic-profile.title: TradingView · Volume profile basic concepts
ic-profile.supports: Trading activity assigned to price levels and lower-timeframe aggregation; not evidence of guaranteed support.

ic-order-details.title: SEC · Trading Basics: order types and instructions
ic-order-details.supports: Stop-limit conversion and possible nonexecution; immediate-or-cancel remainder cancellation; market orders filling at different prices.

ic-macd-details.title: TradingView · Moving average convergence divergence (MACD) indicator
ic-macd-details.supports: MACD fast-minus-slow, signal average and MACD-minus-signal histogram definitions; no effectiveness evidence.

ra-orders.title: SEC / Investor.gov · Understanding Order Types
ra-orders.supports: Market, limit, stop, and stop-limit mechanics; triggered stops do not guarantee execution price. Numerical plans and paths in the chapters are original fictional examples.

ra-performance.title: SEC / Investor.gov · Investor Bulletin: Performance Claims
ra-performance.supports: Scrutiny of hypothetical performance and performance presentations. Journal designs and fictional case calculations are original instructional examples.

ra-behavior.title: SEC · Library of Congress Report: Behavioral Patterns of U.S. Investors
ra-behavior.supports: Overview of investor-behavior research and disposition effect. Proposed decision-recording practices are instructional suggestions, not proven psychological interventions.

ra-overfit.title: Bailey, Borwein, López de Prado & Zhu · The Probability of Backtest Overfitting
ra-overfit.supports: Original research on strategy selection and backtest overfitting. Textbook examples do not implement or claim a computed probability of backtest overfitting.

ra-pattern-research.title: Lo, Mamaysky & Wang · Foundations of Technical Analysis (2000 working paper)
ra-pattern-research.supports: Algorithmic technical-pattern recognition and conditional return-distribution research using historical U.S. stocks. Does not validate all chart methods or net profitability of textbook examples.

ra-nist.title: NIST/SEMATECH · Confidence Intervals for a Binomial Proportion
ra-nist.supports: Binomial proportion confidence-interval methods and assumptions; the 12-of-20 Wilson interval is independently calculated for illustration.

ra-pvalue.title: NIST/SEMATECH · Critical Values and p Values
ra-pvalue.supports: Meaning of a p-value under a specified null hypothesis.

ra-sharpe.title: William F. Sharpe · The Sharpe Ratio (1994)
ra-sharpe.supports: Definition using differential returns and dependence on measurement interval; assumptions behind time scaling.

ra-dow.title: CMT Association · Technically Speaking, September 2016
ra-dow.supports: Practitioner account of Dow trends and confirmation using industrial and railroad averages. Cited for description, not independent proof of returns.

ra-wyckoff.title: Wyckoff Analytics · Wyckoff Method
ra-wyckoff.supports: Proponent description of phases, traditional laws, springs, and Composite Man heuristic. Cited for terminology; interpretations of institutional intent are not treated as observed fact.

ra-elliott.title: Elliott Wave International · Introduction to the Wave Principle
ra-elliott.supports: Proponent account of nested five/three-wave structures and alternate counts. Cited for description, not independent validation of forecasting claims.

ra-elliott-rules.title: Elliott Wave International · Impulse
ra-elliott-rules.supports: Standard-impulse counting constraints; other wave structures require different rules. The textbook schematic omits lower-degree subdivisions.

ra-elliott-constraints.title: Elliott Wave International · Elevate Your Elliott Wave Analysis
ra-elliott-constraints.supports: Proponent description of the three standard impulse rules, distinguished from guidelines. Classification compatibility does not establish forecast probabilities.

ra-dow-reference.title: CMT Association · Technically Speaking, October 2011: Dow Theory
ra-dow-reference.supports: Practitioner definitions of confirmation against each average’s prior secondary-reaction extremes, completed closes, and potentially lagged confirmation; not independent efficacy evidence.

ra-wilson-dataplot.title: NIST Dataplot · Agresti Coull: Wilson score interval
ra-wilson-dataplot.supports: Wilson score interval formula and distinction from adjusted Wald; original 12/20 arithmetic computed independently.

ra-halts.title: SEC / Investor.gov · Trading Halts and Delays
ra-halts.supports: Regulatory versus non-regulatory halts; news-pending halts as the most common regulatory halt; primary-market halts honored by other U.S. markets; exchanges decide. Does not describe reopening prices; Atlas-20 halt accounting is a teaching convention.

ra-wyckoff-text.title: Wyckoff Analytics · Wyckoff Method (author-hosted tutorial PDF)
ra-wyckoff-text.supports: Proponent spring, range and Composite Man definitions, three laws, optional springs and Phase C interpretations; not independent efficacy evidence.

ra-confidence-mean.title: NIST · Confidence Limits for the Mean
ra-confidence-mean.supports: Long-run coverage interpretation and standard-error mean formula; not an exact justification of the textbook’s crude ±2 SE band.

ra-dow-study.title: Brown, Goetzmann & Kumar · The Dow Theory: William Peter Hamilton’s Track Record Reconsidered (1998 author manuscript)
ra-dow-study.supports: Historical reconstruction of editorial timing calls, with execution and sampling limits; not a test of this chapter’s teaching rules. March 13 author version, not a verified copy of the final journal text.

rc-jt.title: Jegadeesh & Titman (1993), Returns to Buying Winners and Selling Losers
rc-jt.supports: Cross-sectional U.S. stock momentum, sample/rule/cost conventions; not validation of a particular chart setup.

rc-ts.title: Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen (2012), Time series momentum
rc-ts.supports: Own-return momentum in 58 futures/forward instruments; gross results and market scope.

rc-bs.title: Bajgrowicz & Scaillet · Technical trading revisited (author-hosted manuscript, sample to July 2011; published 2012)
rc-bs.supports: Multiple-testing, ex ante persistence, transaction costs, and DJIA technical rules.

rc-lo.title: Lo, Mamaysky & Wang (2000), Foundations of Technical Analysis
rc-lo.supports: Algorithmic pattern recognition and conditional return distributions, distinct from net trading profitability.

rc-os.title: Osler (2001), Currency Orders and Exchange-Rate Dynamics, Staff Report 125
rc-os.supports: FX order clustering mechanism; one dealing bank and three currency pairs, not stock-strategy evidence.

rc-bo.title: Barber & Odean (2000), Trading Is Hazardous to Your Wealth
rc-bo.supports: Household turnover and net performance, observed brokerage sample rather than a randomized psychology intervention.

rc-sec-case.title: SEC staff (2021), Equity and Options Market Structure Conditions in Early 2021
rc-sec-case.supports: Dated GME observations in section 3.2; a retrospective staff report, not a contemporaneous signal feed.

rc-sec-reuse.title: SEC · Webmaster Frequently Asked Questions, reuse of content
rc-sec-reuse.supports: Government-created SEC content is free to access and reuse; some site content, such as stock art, is excluded. Not a license for underlying vendor data.

rc-apple-dividend-2016.title: Apple (January 26, 2016), Apple Reports Record First Quarter Results
rc-apple-dividend-2016.supports: Issuer declaration of a $0.52 per-share dividend payable February 11, 2016, to holders of record on February 8, 2016; the February 4 ex-date follows from the then two-business-day ex-date convention, not from this release.

rc-apple-split.title: Apple (April 23, 2014), Capital Return Program and Stock Split
rc-apple-split.supports: Issuer announcement of a seven-for-one split and record/trading dates; no historical OHLC feed.

rc-open-stock-archive.title: Boris Marjanovic / Kaggle · Huge Stock Market Dataset (version 3, CC0)
rc-open-stock-archive.supports: Depositor metadata explicitly applies CC0-1.0 and states dividend/split-adjusted daily OHLC. Local extracts preserve AAPL, MSFT and SPY 2016 rows. Upstream provider, exact session/time zone, adjustment algorithm and point-in-time revisions are not documented; no certified quote feed or execution/performance claim.

rc-cc0.title: Creative Commons · CC0 1.0 Universal deed and legal code
rc-cc0.supports: CC0 states the affirmer waives their copyright and related rights to the extent allowed. Other persons’ rights and warranties are not supplied; this is the recorded permission basis, not chain-of-title certification.
